The strongest non-substrate signal is the low strongest basic pKa and, in some cases, higher TPSA or lower neutral fraction, but the repeated presence of the aromatic/heteroatom scaffold features and the overall local similarity to the substrate neighbors make option (B), is a substrate to the enzyme CYP2D6, the better final prediction.
